integrity: Proof and exact-rational checks are included. The checker is supplemental and does not establish all-dimensional claims by enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Finite-horizon constant rank-one forcing on a controllable nilpotent shift; no arbitrary drift/initial covariance, stationary limit, or floating-point guarantees. Stable-perturbation indefiniteness is pointwise in horizon and panel count.
title: Sharp dimension thresholds for covariance-order errors of positive integrating-factor Runge–Kutta quadratures
